comparison.objective: Open a crown-capped bottle using a fixed opener and serve it upright; candidate tunes and locks a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Record tests carrying a bottle to a fixed jaw, aligning the cap skirt with a catch lip, and applying a controlled downward pull. Candidate tests recessed tool alignment, threaded unlocking/locking, collar rotation, counterholding, and iterative tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires opener-mediated cap removal, bottle tilt below 30 degrees, upright coaster placement, release, and stillness. Candidate requires two non-bottoming stops without hard-stop strike, rebound, overload, or drift; some candidate limits remain undeclared.
comparison.reason: Fixed-fixture alignment and pull-off opening are different tested mechanics from setting a damping parameter and verifying its retained dynamic behavior.
